class.name: SteamCheatEvidence
class.brief_description: Game-owned evidence for one authenticated Steam player report or server finding.
class.description: Create evidence in the trusted game backend after checking match membership. Use [method player] with the exact [SteamIdentity] the same publisher verified. Use [method server] for authoritative server evidence your policy can verify. The match reference stays in the backend and the reason code becomes Steam's app data.

method.name: player
method.description: Returns evidence for the [param match_id] and positive [param reason_code] submitted by [param reporter]. Report submission checks that the identity belongs to this publisher.

method.name: server
method.description: Returns authoritative server evidence for [param match_id] and positive [param reason_code]. The game policy verifies the server and match context before approving the report.

method.name: get_match_id
method.description: Returns the game-owned match reference for review.

method.name: get_reason_code
method.description: Returns the positive game-defined reason code sent as Steam app data.

method.name: get_source
method.description: Returns whether a player or the authoritative game server submitted the evidence.

method.name: get_reporter_steam_id
method.description: Returns the authenticated reporter's SteamID64, or empty for server evidence.

members.member: The game-owned match reference for review.
The positive game-defined reason code sent as Steam app data.
Whether a player or the authoritative game server submitted the evidence.
The authenticated reporter's SteamID64, or empty for server evidence.

constants.constant: A player authenticated by the exact issuing publisher.
An authoritative game server verified by the trusted policy.
